Name: Train Tag
Author: Taskmaster2
Description:
Recently the Stardew Valley Railroad Authority (SVRA) experienced a rise in railcars being vandalized with profanity and inappropriate images, which cost money and time to remove and repaint.  In order to reduce the vandalism, engage with the community, and encourage mutual respect for property, the Stardew Valley Railroad Authority held a contest to find a talented local artist that would be given the privilege of "tagging" a few railcars with beautiful, community-appropriate graffiti.  You were the lucky winner and have been granted the privilege of tagging the railcars with graffiti of your choice!

See the Readme.Txt for details!

If you like this MOD you might want to check out my other mods as well.
